messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Bonjour
parts:
Saibou:

French is not my first language, but I think you want to know how to
download the Distance software and how to use it for your primate
inventories.

You can visit this webpage to learn how to download the software
http://distancesampling.org/Distance/old-versions/distance62download.html

and you can read a number of papers that describe the use of distance
sampling for the estimation of abundance of primates:

http://distancesampling.org/dbib.html
type in the search term "primate"
